newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes eight cents down at 14.77 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes eight cents down at 14.77 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell eights cents to 14.77 ringgit ($5.85) a kg, on a correction to the market's sharp rise before the New Year holiday.

"The LME (London Metal Exchange) went up overnight but it was not to cover the local market's rise on New Year's eve," said a trader in Malaysia. The Kuala Lumpur Tin Market closed 25 cents higher on Tuesday.
Offers outnumbered bids by 86 tonnes to 17. Turnover was 41 tonnes against 201 on Tuesday. The local premium against London narrowed to $170 a tonne from $270 previously, traders said.
